scientific_integrity: A self-contained exact inequality proves the dimension-uniform sharp value; polynomial and finite Walsh tests are supplementary and do not replace proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the non-prefix two-lag set {N-2,N-1} for N>=4; the statistical corollary requires independent proper zero-mean unit-variance symbols of common fourth moment below two; other lag sets and alphabet restrictions remain outside scope. Novelty is assessed against inspected literature only.
title: The sharp two-tail-lag correlation energy for unitary Fourier modulations
